job: Operate an existing repository's GitHub pull-request and GitHub Release delivery lifecycle with inspect-first, commit-pinned, separately authorized writes.
real_inputs: Repository remotes, policy, version files, changelog, tags, and workflow definitions
GitHub PR, check-run, workflow-run, tag, Release, and asset state
User-selected review feedback, approved local edit plans, and action-specific authorization
primary_output: A verified PR or release action report that names the resolved target, evidence state, authorization boundary, performed writes, and fresh-read result.
description: Extend the existing PR lifecycle skill with release PR preparation, tag and draft Release publication, verified assets, and release workflow diagnosis while preserving neighboring skill boundaries.
exclusions: Direct npm, cargo, or PyPI publication
Full-spectrum repository health or release-readiness audits
constraints: No GitHub write without action-specific authorization
Never delete, move, or re-push published version tags
Missing or ambiguous target-commit evidence stops publication
No new scripts for release operations
standards: Default initial load at or below 1000 tokens
Trigger positives, negatives, and near neighbors all pass
Governed score at least 90 with zero blockers
Output eval covers file-backed, near-neighbor, and boundary cases
correction: The reviewed design added release topology classification, complete fresh-run evidence, peeled tag OID handling, artifact provenance, and separate Latest authorization before implementation.
